phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase A2 — F2M External Complement Identity Audit

direct_W2_total_economy_publication.interpretation: The direct total-economy W2 F2M series was unavailable and was not treated as zero.

scientific_interpretation: Each resident-holder row has exactly one unresolved issuer after structural non-issuers H/C and resident issuer columns F/G/BNR are resolved: X.
Each holder→X candidate is therefore a unique row complement to an observed W0 holder total, not an allocation of an external aggregate by shares.
The independently observed/derived domestic bilateral submatrix reconciles to published total-economy W0 minus published W1 for both stock and flow.
The sum of resident-holder W0 controls reconciles to published total-economy W0.
The sum of the five independently derived holder→X complements reconciles to the published total-economy W1 control.
Published statistical precision explains the small residuals; every residual is within the preregistered 0.1 million RON tolerance.
limitations: Direct total-economy W2 F2M publication was unavailable.
This audit establishes eligibility for exact complement derivation; it does not itself write values to an accounting benchmark.
F2M remains deposits only. Total F2 remains blocked by F21 currency identification.

next_gate.name: F2M component materialization
next_gate.rule: Materialize F2M only as a separate component accounting artifact with immutable raw provenance and deterministic offline regeneration. Do not write F2M values into the canonical total-F2 matrix.
